title: Lemonade Album Cover
coreRelationships: The fur garment dominates the foreground, creating a soft, textured frame for the partially visible head.

The text 'LEMONADE' is positioned directly over the fur, creating a clear focal point and integrating with the texture.
The muted background provides depth and separation without distracting from the central subject and text.
